meta.title: Scienteens Lab Projects
meta.description: Workshops and project ideas developed by Jonas Evrard for science outreach with teenagers.

hero.title: Workshops and project ideas.
hero.introduction: This page presents activities I have built or am currently developing. The first detailed project is a workshop on standing waves using a Kundt tube.

currentProject.title: Sound Made Visible: Standing Waves in a Kundt Tube
currentProject.summary: Students create resonances in an air column, observe the standing-wave pattern and use measurements to estimate the speed of sound.
currentProject.description: A loudspeaker drives the air inside the tube. Students change the frequency, identify resonances and compare the observed pattern with the wave model. Lightweight particles and a microphone make the response of the air column easier to locate and measure.
objectives: Identify resonant frequencies and distinguish successive modes.
Relate the boundary conditions to nodes and antinodes.
Measure the distance between equivalent nodes to determine the wavelength.
Calculate the speed of sound from frequency and wavelength.

sequence.title: Predict
sequence.text: Choose where nodes and antinodes should appear before switching on the sound.

sequence.title: Tune
sequence.text: Vary the frequency and identify a clear resonance of the air column.

sequence.title: Observe
sequence.text: Compare the visible or measured response with the predicted mode.

sequence.title: Measure
sequence.text: Record the frequency and the distance between equivalent nodes.

sequence.title: Calculate
sequence.text: Determine the wavelength and estimate the speed of sound.

futureProjects.title: Entropy on a Chessboard
futureProjects.summary: Use the distribution of possible moves to compare uncertainty, choice and the fragility of different chess positions.

futureProjects.title: Physics on Two Wheels
futureProjects.summary: Use a bicycle, a slope and gear ratios to measure force, power and efficiency in a system students already know.

futureProjects.title: Light, Claims and Measurements
futureProjects.summary: Turn claims about light into testable questions, then use simple measurements to decide what the evidence supports.
